selection_status: Fixed before extension outcome computation; lab us-core-22 and us-core-3 expression changes were inspected during feasibility research.
completion_domain: Complete immutable Observation resources with fixed code; supported value choices absent, string or Quantity; fully observed root arrays. All array lengths are covered by existential/universal predicates, not by a length cutoff.
cost_boundary: Initial full-resource parsing, structural verification, old validation, synthetic fixture generation and projection preparation are setup/sunk costs. No previously unread source claim is made. Retained-fragment evidence and subsequent logical root-field retrieval are measured separately; this study does not measure network requests.
oracle_boundary: Exact versioned machine-readable supported invariant fragment, not all FHIR/profile conformance or clinical correctness. Complete resources only are sent to standard engines. Full-validator issues and unresolved terminology/reference issues remain separate.
dataset_boundary: Published specification examples and exhaustive synthetic structural categories; neither a hospital log nor a clinical prevalence sample.
authoritative_old_verdict: Not used as an independent completion-domain restriction. Retained observations must themselves certify the old fragment verdict.
